content.title: Yum! Brands (YUM) Net Margin Decline Challenges Bullish Profitability Narratives
content.summary: Yum! Brands (YUM) posted an 18% net profit margin, down from 21.1% a year earlier, with earnings growing 4.5% per year over the last five years. Looking ahead, analysts project future earnings growth of roughly 11.7% and revenue growth of 6.2% per year, both trailing the broader US market. Amid modest growth forecasts and a demanding valuation, investor attention centers on whether Yum! can deliver consistent earnings quality and maintain profitability as growth expectations rise. content.title: ​Papa John’s Drops After Report Says Deal Is Shelved
content.summary: ​Papa John’s International’s shares tumbled about 10% after a report that a private-equity firm backed off a potential deal to acquire the pizza brand.  Apollo Global Management recently had bid to take Papa John’s private but withdrew that offer about a week ago, Reuters reported Wednesday.  Papa John’s is due to report quarterly results Thursday.
